footer.ctaTitle: Ready for a greener collection experience?
footer.ctaSubtitle: Book today for a transparent quote, clear sorting and eco-friendly operations.
footer.brandDesc: Professional, fast and eco-friendly collection services for old items.

step01.title: Select item type
step01.desc: Select item group, size and unit. If not listed, send a special request with photos.

step02.title: Address & Time
step02.desc: System checks address, confirms available times and shows necessary operation notes.

step03.title: Quote Confirmation
step03.desc: Estimated price for standard items, special items switch to manual quote mode.

step04.title: Payment / Finish
step04.desc: Customer confirms payment method, admin or staff accepts and confirms schedule.

step05.title: Track & Complete
step05.desc: Track collection and processing status, and provide a review once completed.

auth.sidebarTitle: Book without an account, but having one is much better
auth.sidebarSubtitle: Guests can still book normally. An account is just an added layer: save info, get vouchers, and track orders more conveniently.

voucher.title: Member Voucher
voucher.desc: Register to receive a 10% discount on your next booking and campaign-based discount codes.

history.title: Save Address & Order History
history.desc: Automatically refill previously used info, making future bookings faster.

tracking.title: Convenient Order Tracking
tracking.desc: View progress, email confirmations, and personalized promotions all in one account.

auth.suggestion: Currently, members register after first booking to receive a voucher for the next order instead of at checkout to limit abuse.

login.title: Account Login
login.footer: Login to auto-fill your email and use member vouchers in future bookings.

register.title: Create EcoCollect Account
register.policy: I agree to receive order confirmation emails, member vouchers, and promotional info tailored to collection needs.
register.footer: Registration is optional for the current order. Guests can still book fast if they prefer.

specialCase.title: Can't find your item on the list?
specialCase.desc: New flow allows entering custom description, sending photos, and switching items to manual quote mode instead of forcing a wrong category.

booking.title: Smart Collection Schedule
booking.subtitle: Choose the right item and quantity. Some bulky items have size options, while construction waste is entered directly in kg.
booking.searchPlaceholder: Search for item: sofa, wardrobe, e-scooter...

sofa-single.name: Single Sofa
sofa-single.desc: Collect single sofas or large single chairs.

sofa-large.name: Double Sofa / L-shape
sofa-large.desc: Suitable for double sofas, corner sofas or large sofa sets.

wardrobe.name: Wardrobe
wardrobe.desc: Size-classified to reflect correct transport load.

kitchen-cabinet.name: Kitchen / Shoe Cabinet
kitchen-cabinet.desc: Small cabinets, low shelves or shoe racks.

bed.name: Bed / Mattress
bed.desc: Applies to bed frames, single or double mattresses.

tv.name: TV / Monitor
tv.desc: TV, monitor or mid-size display device.

fridge.name: Refrigerator
fridge.desc: Bulky cooling appliance requiring special handling.

washer.name: Washing Machine

aircon.name: Old Air Conditioner

office-furniture.name: Office Desk / Chair
office-furniture.desc: Work desk, office chair or swivel chair.

household-bag.name: Household Bags
household-bag.desc: For sealed bags ready for quick loading.

construction.name: Construction Waste

custom.name: Other Items

about.title: Eco-tech collection platform for modern cities
about.desc: EcoCollect helps customers book fast collections, with transparent pricing and tracking from receipt to recycling.

mission.title: Reduce landfill, increase reuse
mission.desc: Each order is routed to prioritize sorting, recycling, and reuse instead of just being dumped.

difference.title: Easy booking, clear quotes, transparent status
difference.desc: Customers know what they pay for, staff know what to handle, and admins have data to optimize operations.

handling.title: Green Processing
handling.text: Routed by item group to increase recycling and reduce landfill.

operation.title: Smart Operations
operation.text: Prices estimated by item type, size, unit, and complexity.

transparency.title: End-to-end Transparency
transparency.text: Track status from booking, collection, processing to completion.

brandStory.sidebarTitle: A green brand with a tech and reliable feel.
brandStory.cta: Book to experience our new flow

pricing.title: Why Choose Us
pricing.note: Prices above are estimates. Final price confirmed based on item type, size, and collection conditions.

realtime.title: Real-time Pricing
realtime.desc: Price calculated instantly when you select items and quantity.

shipping.title: Home Pickup
shipping.desc: Our team comes to you, no need to transport yourself.

green.title: Green Processing
green.desc: Prioritize recycling and reuse to minimize landfill waste.

payment.title: Flexible Payment
payment.desc: Cash or bank transfer, pay when collection is done.

ontime.title: Always On Time
ontime.desc: We commit to arriving in your chosen time slot, and notify you if anything changes.

insured.title: Insured
insured.desc: Your items are protected during transport and processing.
